Name: Mattithiah, Son of Shallum
Summary: Firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, who had the set office over the things made in the pans.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:31: Firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, who had the set office over the things made in the pans.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Mattithiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
